CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Study Methods Devotional Method to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Bible Study Methods Devotional Method has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Study Methods Devotional Method.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings.
   B. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.
   C. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

5. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.
   B. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Schism and Syncretism in Israel.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.
   C. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.
   C. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Moral Issues Facing the Youth Today and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Challenges Facing Marriage and Family Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Law, Order and Justice and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Modern medicine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. D — Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

5. C — Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. C — Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Moral Issues Facing the Youth Today; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Challenges Facing Marriage and Family Life; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Law, Order and Justice; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Modern medicine; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
